powerSave.title: Power-save mode
powerSave.desc: Temporarily pauses typing/music/fullscreen detection, roaming, and all idle animations without restarting the app. Resets again the next time DeskyBuddy starts.

character.title: Character
character.desc: Choose who roams around your screen.

autostart.title: Start automatically
autostart.warningHtml: ⚠️ Autostart is enabled, but Windows has blocked it. Please enable "DeskyBuddy" (or "Electron") manually under Settings → Apps → Startup.

mouseLook.title: Eyes follow the mouse
mouseLook.desc: DeskyBuddy looks in the direction of your mouse cursor.

typingDetection.title: Typing detection
typingDetection.desc: Sits down with a laptop when you type a lot. Only counts keystrokes, never stores what you type.

musicDetection.title: Music detection
musicDetection.desc: Puts on headphones when music is currently playing (Spotify, YouTube Music, ...).

afkDetection.title: Away detection
afkDetection.desc: DeskyBuddy gets drowsy (Zzz) after a few minutes without keyboard or mouse activity — runs alongside idle animations without interrupting them.

multiMonitorFollow.title: Follow multiple monitors
multiMonitorFollow.desc: DeskyBuddy switches to whichever monitor your active window (or mouse) is currently on.

hideFullscreen.title: Hide during fullscreen apps
hideFullscreen.desc: DeskyBuddy hides itself while an app is running in fullscreen.

alwaysDay.title: Always day mode
alwaysDay.desc: DeskyBuddy always looks like it's daytime, even at night — for every character.

idle.title: Idle animations
idle.desc: How often DeskyBuddy does a little action on its own (reading, yawning, rolling dice, ...) when it isn't doing anything else.

statsDecay.title: Affection/hunger decay
statsDecay.desc: Affection and fullness drift back down over time if you don't pet or feed DeskyBuddy for a while.

moodAffectsAnimations.title: Mood affects animations
moodAffectsAnimations.desc: Some idle animations only show up when DeskyBuddy is especially happy, grumpy, or hungry.

menuBarMode.title: Menu bar mode
menuBarMode.desc: DeskyBuddy hangs from the menu bar at the top instead of roaming the Dock area at the bottom.

settings.waylandWarning: ⚠️ Wayland session detected: typing detection, away detection, and hiding during fullscreen games don't work under Wayland and stay disabled.

wardrobeEnabled.title: Wardrobe
wardrobeEnabled.desc: Dress DeskyBuddy up in unlocked accessories.

seasonalWardrobe.title: Seasonal costumes
seasonalWardrobe.desc: Some accessories unlock themselves automatically at the right time of year.

weatherReaction.title: Weather reaction
weatherReaction.desc: DeskyBuddy dresses for the current weather at your location (e.g. an umbrella when it's raining).
